subject: expression: support `timestampdiff` pushdown to tikv (#59366)
summary: This commit only enables TiKV pushdown for `timestampdiff` by adding `ast.TimestampDiff` to the TiKV-supported scalar function list (`pkg/expression/infer_pushdown.go:213`) and adds pushdown coverage in `pkg/expression/expr_to_pb_test.go`. No evaluation/semantic logic for `timestampdiff` is changed (the existing PbCode `tipb.ScalarFuncSig_TimestampDiff` was already present), and upstream/master retains this enablement; no Blocker/High issues found in the expression scope.
